hints: The trap: 'left child < node < right child' at every node is not enough. A key deep in the left subtree must also be smaller than every ANCESTOR it is left of.
Pass an allowed open interval (lo, hi) down the recursion. Left child gets (lo, node->key); right child gets (node->key, hi).
Use long long bounds starting outside the int range so that keys equal to INT_MIN or INT_MAX are not rejected by the sentinels.
source: Classic BST question; uses the PD Lab 10 tree notation
title: Is this binary tree a BST?
